name: Are you following a secure systems software development life cycle policy or process?
conditionsText:
The appropriate process will depend on the service, but should incorporate relevant security activities throughout development, such as:
- threat modelling
- secure design
- code review
- automated security testing
- dependency checking
- vulnerability scanning
- remediation
- appropriate security testing before deployment.
requirementTitle: Are you following a secure systems software development life cycle policy or process?
requirementDescription: Is security built into the way the service is designed, developed, tested, deployed and maintained, rather than being checked only at the end?
why:
Security problems are generally easier to address when they are identified as part of normal development rather than after the service is complete or live.
A secure development lifecycle encourages teams to consider security while, Designing 
Building
Reviewing
Testing 
Deploying 
Operating
rather than relying solely on a final security assessment.
tasks: Are you following a secure systems software development life cycle policy or process?

actions.title: Are you following a secure systems software development life cycle policy or process?
actions.description:
• Have an agreed secure development lifecycle or development process.
• Define the security activities required at appropriate development stages.
• Build appropriate security checks into development and deployment workflows.
• Define who is responsible for completing those checks.
• Record and address vulnerabilities discovered.
• Continue security testing after the service goes live.
